role: Rust library crate of shared infrastructure for the meta CLI ecosystem: ~/.meta/ data-directory management, PID-staleness file locking, atomic lock-protected JSON store, and a large .meta.yaml config module (config.rs ~40K). northstar: Meta makes multi-repo feel like monorepo without the downsides; the canon machinery stays green, versioned by the parent distribution.
